nodes.label: Space Survival 3D production rules (Blender to Unity)
nodes.rationale: Reference for every session that models, animates or integrates a model in Space Survival; project-specific DA.

nodes.label: §0 Façon de travailler avec l'utilisateur
nodes.rationale: User iterates visually: renders after each model, direct export, honest about unverified Unity behaviour; validated models are not redrawn.

nodes.label: §1.1 Esprit général
nodes.rationale: Subnautica-inspired modular bases, own DA, clean industrial high-tech, simple silhouettes.

nodes.label: §1.2 Palette (flat materials)
nodes.rationale: Per-model M_<Model>_<Suffix> materials; suffix drives automatic Unity .mat creation.

nodes.label: §1.3 Formes
nodes.rationale: No sharp 90° edges; facets rather than smooth shapes; detail via small add-on elements.

nodes.label: §1.5 Vitres
nodes.rationale: Thin closed prisms, never single planes (incoherent normals, missing glass).

nodes.label: §1.6 Textures
nodes.rationale: Manufactured objects: textures paused, detail in geometry. Natural elements: textures mandatory, the inverse of machines (simple shapes, detail carried by texture).

nodes.label: §1.7 Éléments naturels (roches, gisements, items de ressource)
nodes.rationale: Subnautica natural decor reference: detailed but stylised (not realistic) rock textures; machines stay flat-colour.

nodes.label: §2 Méthode de modélisation (Blender, procédural)
nodes.rationale: Everything generated by Python bmesh scripts, never hand-modelled.

nodes.label: §8 Erreurs déjà commises
nodes.rationale: Catalogue of past mistakes not to repeat.

nodes.label: No 90° sharp edges (chamfer or 6 mm edge break EB)
nodes.rationale: Every edge gets a wide 45° chamfer or EB = 0.006.

nodes.label: Facets rather than smooth shapes (oct_cyl, geodesic domes)
Small add-on details 1-6 mm above surface (screws, neon, vents)
Standard flange (PASS, SHELL, offset_poly, screws every 55 cm)
nodes.rationale: Every module that joins the network must reuse it; chained via Socket empties.

nodes.label: Solid walls max 1.20 m, glazed above
Player collider ~0.85 m x 1.70 m; doors >= 1.1 x 1.9 m
LandingCapsule (hollow faceted shell, flush ramp door)
nodes.rationale: Door hinge 4.5 cm outside sill; open_angle() computed so the leaf touches the ground; leaf stops 7.5 cm under lintel.

nodes.label: Storage kit (Crate_Small, Crate_Large, Cabinet)
nodes.rationale: Lid covers full top; hinge axis 2 cm outside lid edge (HINGE_OFF); StackPoint for stacking.

nodes.label: WallScreen (curved wall TV)
nodes.rationale: Radius tighter than smallest dome (3.6 m back) on a 2.5 cm graphite plate so edges never cut any of the three walls; single-piece smooth sweep avoids corner seams.

nodes.label: Dome inner wall cylinder R_OUT-0.25 (3.75/5.75/7.75 m)
Manufactured objects: textures paused, flat materials
nodes.rationale: Detail lives in the geometry for machines and buildings.

nodes.label: Natural elements: textures mandatory
nodes.rationale: Inverse of machines: simple shapes, detail carried by the texture.

nodes.label: Per-material texture <MaterialName>_BaseColor.png/_Normal.png next to .mat (e.g. M_Rocks_Basalt_BaseColor.png)
nodes.rationale: Textured Standard material; metallic/smoothness taken from the suffix in FlatPalette.

nodes.label: Subnautica natural decor reference
nodes.rationale: Machines simple/flat; rock has detailed but stylised (not realistic) textures: soft hue variation, spots, cracks, normal-map relief. Never copy an existing asset.

nodes.label: Subnautica inspiration (modular bases)
nodes.rationale: Own DA, never copy an existing asset.

nodes.label: No wild flora (arid Mars-like planet)
nodes.rationale: Only cultivated terrestrial plants in domes (food, wood: F53); no alien plants for now.

nodes.label: One dominant colour per rock
nodes.rationale: A rock is orange OR dark grey, never mixed; no per-facet colours (dust on top, shadow below) — too simplistic and faces came out pink in Unity. All hue variation goes through the texture.

nodes.label: Shapes between faceted and organic (rock_hull soft=N)
nodes.rationale: Neither large flat facets nor smooth pebble; §1.3 chamfer/edge-break and no-90° rules do not apply; smooth shading with sharp at 40°.

nodes.label: rock_hull (convex hull of noisy ellipsoid points + 1-3 break planes)
soften() (subdivision, two 50% smooths, fractal noise bumps 7%)
Large blocks as clusters of 2-3 interpenetrating hulls (ground_rock)
Ground anchoring: origin at ground contact, base sunk 8-15% of height
nodes.rationale: Never float on terrain slope.

nodes.label: Fixed seed per model random.Random(name)
nodes.rationale: Rerunning gives identical shapes; validated variants are not retouched.

nodes.label: No add-on detail on natural elements (screws, neon, panels)
Tileable textures via 4D torus (cos u, sin u, cos v, sin v) baked in Cycles
nodes.rationale: Seamless repeat: square UVs mapped onto a 4D torus feeding 4D noise/voronoi; Emit for colour, tangent-space Normal.

nodes.label: Texture layers (large spots, marbling, grain, painted voronoi spots, masked fine cracks, pores, strata, flakes, malachite rings)
nodes.rationale: Cracks masked by noise, never a regular tiling.

nodes.label: One shared texture per type (Basalt, RockOrange, Iron, Copper, Titanium, Coal)
nodes.rationale: Editing a recipe in RECIPES and rerunning bake() changes all rocks of that type at once.

nodes.label: box_uv (object-space box projection)
nodes.rationale: Each face uses the plane of its dominant normal axis; same texel density across a kit; seams drowned in noise.

nodes.label: UV_TILE[kit] (Rocks 1.2 m, Deposits 0.8 m, ResourceItems 0.35 m)
Export copies textures as M_<Kit>_<Name>_BaseColor/_Normal.png next to .mat
nodes.rationale: Delete the .mat to regenerate it on import.

nodes.label: _Basalt natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Dark grey basalt; rock and host rock of deposits; texture Basalt

nodes.label: _RockOrange natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Orange rock, texture RockOrange. Not _Orange: that suffix is the machines' emissive indicator lights

nodes.label: _Iron natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Iron veins (dark red hematite, flakes), metal 0.55 / gloss 0.5

nodes.label: _Copper natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Copper veins (green ringed malachite), 0.2 / 0.55

nodes.label: _Titanium natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Titanium veins (bluish crystalline grey), 0.85 / 0.75

nodes.label: _Coal natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Coal strata (glossy flaked black), 0.1 / 0.85

nodes.label: _Ice natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Pale blue ice blocks, flat colour, gloss 0.9

nodes.label: _Diamond natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Bluish-white diamonds, slight emission

nodes.label: _Quartz natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Milky white quartz, flat

nodes.label: _Amethyst natural material suffix
nodes.rationale: Purple amethyst, flat

nodes.label: Crystals opaque and flat (no _Glass)
nodes.rationale: Standard transparency sorts overlapping crystal clusters badly; rely on high gloss and the diamond's small emission.

nodes.label: Rock kit (Rocks/, 18 Rock_<Basalt|Orange>_<S|M|L>_<1..3>)
nodes.rationale: S 0.35-0.55 m pebble, M 0.9-1.4 m low obstacle, L 2.4-3.4 m block/cluster; 2 cuts for S, 3 for M/L (~200-2500 tris).

nodes.label: Hand-harvestable deposits kit (Deposits/, 24 Deposit_<Resource>_<1..3>)
nodes.rationale: 0.7-1.0 m; host rock always basalt, single colour; ~900-7000 tris; drill outcrops will be a separate kit later.

nodes.label: Picked-up resource items kit (ResourceItems/, 9 Item_*)
nodes.rationale: 10-18 cm, origin at bottom centre; ore chunk entirely in the ore material; crystals on a basalt shard; diamond/quartz/amethyst items do not exist yet (models only).

nodes.label: Organic veins with local subdivision, raised 8 mm (veins())
nodes.rationale: Contour computed face by face on dense mesh: wavy centre line, noisy width, tapered ends. Local 2-cut subdivision avoids sawtooth contour; 8 mm extrusion along normals avoids z-fighting. Iron/Copper/Titanium: 2-4 veins from one top area, never wrapping around; Coal: 2 near-horizontal strata.

nodes.label: Protruding crystals (Quartz hex bouquets, Amethyst squat clusters, Diamond octahedra, Ice blocks)
nodes.rationale: Planted 3-5 cm under the surface, tilted skyward around the surface normal.

nodes.label: Natural element hierarchy: root empty + single static Body mesh, convex MeshCollider
nodes.rationale: Body.001 renamed to Body at export like Socket; L cluster rocks may need non-convex collider.

nodes.label: Procedural bmesh generation, one xx_build.py per model
fix_normals (outward normals per closed island by volume sign)
Axis convention: z=0 ground, front -Y Blender = +Z Unity
Hierarchy: root empty, PascalCase children, moving parts with pivot origin
Mandatory FBX export parameters (axis_forward -Z, up Y, FBX_SCALE_UNITS)
Export folder Assets/Resources/Models/<Model>/ (FBX = root = folder name)
nodes.rationale: Name is the key in ModelImportSetup.cs.

nodes.label: Temporary rename to avoid Socket.001 in FBX
bakeAxisConversion=false and preserveHierarchy=true for all models
nodes.rationale: Otherwise the model tips 90° when a clip plays.

nodes.label: Check Editor.log for error CS after script edits
Single 24 fps timeline per model, clips separated by 10-18 frames
Clip pairs forward/back with stable end poses
BVHTree.overlap collision test sampled over all frames
Current clip tables (CraftStation, Airlock, RelayAntenna, SolarPanel, WindTurbine, CoalGenerator, LandingCapsule, Drill, Crate_Small, Crate_Large, Cabinet, ControlPanel)
ModelLayers (one Animator layer per independent motion group)
nodes.rationale: OnPostprocessAnimation strips curves of other layers' objects; Write Defaults off.

nodes.label: Animator pitfall: script-driven transforms keep own angle applied in LateUpdate
nodes.rationale: Animator rewrites every animated transform each frame; never incremental Rotate.

nodes.label: Clear public verb API (Deploy, Fold, Toggle...), gameplay never calls clips
Instance Animator must receive its .controller manually
nodes.rationale: User does not want scripts to load it automatically.
